response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical depth, open-source contributions, and leadership in diverse projects, but lacks demonstrated experience in IT architecture design, UML modeling, and client-facing advisory roles critical for this executive position, and his German proficiency is only basic — a hard requirement.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with real-world impact (e.g., GISCollective)
Proven full-stack leadership across multiple technologies and domains
Strong track record in mentoring, workshops, and team knowledge sharing
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic (C1 required)
No explicit evidence of UML, IT architecture design, or requirements management experience
Lacks documented experience in technical project management or client advisory roles
